normalization: CCF1 schema/operator version source15-v1. Path subject/target must equal body when duplicated. Complete Company/type/subject/period/assessment/qualification correlation rechecked by owners; shape alone is not authority. Previous subject_source_generation wire name now denotes captured Company WAGE family generation in this codec; it is a staleness witness, not an employee-row version. Relevant predecessor/source equality must be re-resolved before mutation.
preparation: Source expectations are optional staleness witnesses; authoritative population and source selection always server-derived. Empty source witness list never skips source guards or eligibility checks.
create_identity: For a draft seal allocate final target before hashing and persist in attempt. For allowed direct create, allocate only after authoritative Company command/provenance absence under fence; store target in immutable receipt; retry reconstructs fingerprint using that original allocated target, never a new UUID. Client-provided target is selector only and cannot override owner allocation. Native run correlation UUID remains distinct.
bounds: Wire/normalized command64KiB/depth8; ref list max32 except explicitly bounded segment list128; source reader streams one employee event buffer, not2000times4096events in memory. Large manifests are owner rows+refs. All selected required people retained; hidden/over-limit data blocks rather than truncates.
cross_checks: Every Company in refs matches target unless an explicit Docs share/admission already minted target-Company refs
One Employment identity with full eligible segmented month coverage; no account workforce prerequisite
Selection/period/pay_date and taxable basis exactly match verified assessment
Qualification kind/date/edition and locator schema/units/notes match exact artifact attestation
Any JSON extra/duplicate key or unsupported source value rejects before new effect; historical receipt reconciliation precedes new validity checks
credential_rules: EA1.7 governs nonrecursive issuer bootstrap, purpose matching, current revoked/expired trust and AI1 distinct humans. Registered identifiers come only from pinned issuer profile, not arbitrary tenant labels. ProfessionalCredentialRef must target REVIEWER_CREDENTIAL; shape alone is insufficient. valid_to > valid_from; finite validity. All issuer, subject and scope correlations checked server-side.
